newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Unilever chief to head British Gas unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Unilever chief to head British Gas unit - paper.

text.p: Former Unilever chief Sir Michael Perry is expected to be appointed chairman of Centrica, the gas sales and trading company to be formed through the demerger of British Gas, the Sunday Telegraph reported.

The appointment is expected to be announced shortly, since British Gas will this week publish the documents about its demerger ahead of the February 12 shareholders' meeting which will vote on the planned break-up, the newspaper said.

British Gas chairman Richard Giordano was expected to leave Centrica in May, but will remain chairman of BG, which will comprise the gas transportation and storage business along with exploration and production activities, the Telegraph said.
Perry has been a non-executive director of British Gas since 1994 and was appointed a non-executive of Centrica last month, it added.
No one at the company could be reached for comment.
